Type: rustic oak sideboard
Use: storing tableware and linens, serving surface; dining room, living room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: solid oak with distressed finish, metal knob pulls
Colors: warm honey oak, antique pewter
Shape: long rectangular case, overhanging top, three drawers over three paneled doors, short square legs, sturdy and substantial
Feel: warm, homely, solid
Goes with: cream walls, linen textiles, wrought iron accents; farmhouse or country dining rooms

Type: tall six-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes; bedroom

Feel: rich, refined, polished
Goes with: cream bedding, warm neutral walls, chrome accents; contemporary or transitional bedrooms
